template: Open {{v1}} in the browser. If a sign-in page appears, sign in with username admin and password admin. If Grafana then asks you to change/skip updating the password, choose Skip (keep admin/admin). Then navigate to the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health' (use the search/dashboards feature to find it) and open it. Report the exact titles of every panel visible on that dashboard, exactly as shown on screen, in order.
